snippet.title: Titan Quest II | Spirit Mastery Deep Dive Trailer
snippet.description:
The Spirit Mastery has arrived!

Manipulate the forces of life and death to summon spirits of the dead, cast otherworldly spells to haunt the living, and discover a new way to play Titan Quest II. Alongside it comes our first Crafting update, letting you salvage and enhance your gear.

Join Early Access and try the new Spirit Mastery and Crafting right now.
